facts.value: The placement test is for 'Courses for all students' and is recommended to assess your language level. Placement tests in 3 languages (English, French & Spanish) can be taken. The test assesses subject-specific vocabulary, grammar, and comprehension through single-choice, matching, and fill-in-the-blank tasks to find the best possible course for your level.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The placement test can be taken online from home at any time. It takes approximately 30 minutes to complete.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The result is a recommendation and does not lead to mandatory participation in the respective level. However, it is strongly recommended to adhere to this assessment.
